suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: Top-left cluster: the 'Primase' text label and the 'RNA Primer' label are drawn at the same y (~150px) and print on top of each other ('PrimRNA Primer'), making both unreadable.; Solution: Line 42: self.place_at_grid(primase_label, 'A1', scale_factor=0.7) (label sits one row above the primase circle at B1, color #B07CC6); self.place_at_grid(primer_top_label, 'C2', scale_factor=0.7) (moves the orange #E8A33D 'RNA Primer' caption one row below its primer bar at B2). Keep primase_circle at B1 and the primer bar at B2 so no caption shares a cell.

[LAYOUT] Problem: Top-right cluster: after DNA Pol slides up, its 'DNA Pol' caption, the yellow "5' → 3'" caption and the grey 'Template' label all pile into A3-A4 (~y 90-145) and overlap each other and the template line.; Solution: Line 68: self.place_at_grid(template_top_label, 'A2', scale_factor=0.7) (grey #9AA7B0 caption above the line start); self.place_at_grid(dna_pol_top, 'A4', scale_factor=0.8) and self.place_at_grid(dna_pol_top_label, 'A5', scale_factor=0.7) (cyan #35B8C9 caption to the right of the enzyme); self.place_at_grid(direction_label, 'B4', scale_factor=0.7) (yellow #F2D024 "5' → 3'" below the arrow, clear of the green fragments).

[LAYOUT] Problem: Bottom strand captions 'RNA Primer', 'Okazaki', 'Gap', 'Okazaki' are stacked on the same 20px band (~y 305-325) and overlap; the lower 'DNA Pol' caption also collides with the bottom 'Template' label.; Solution: Line 95: self.place_at_grid(primer_bottom_label, 'D1', scale_factor=0.6); self.place_at_grid(okazaki_label_1, 'E3', scale_factor=0.6); self.place_at_grid(okazaki_label_2, 'E4', scale_factor=0.6); self.place_at_grid(gap_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.6); self.place_at_grid(template_bottom_label, 'F4', scale_factor=0.7); self.place_at_grid(dna_pol_bottom, 'F5', scale_factor=0.8) with self.place_at_grid(dna_pol_bottom_label, 'F6', scale_factor=0.7). Also FadeOut gap_label and both okazaki_labels when 'Sealed' appears at E3 so stale captions do not linger under the ligase step.
